questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. The rapid urbanization led to many serious problems. One of those is the growth of slums.
options: A. The rapid urbanization is the cause of many serious problems such as the growth of slums.
B. The rapid urbanization is consequent of many serious problems like the growth of slums.
C. The rapid urbanization is created by many serious problems such as the growth of slums.
D. The rapid urbanization is resulted by many serious problems like the growth of slums.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Urbanization là nguyên nhân gây ra vấn đề → dùng “is the cause of” (là nguyên nhân của). Dịch nghĩa: Quá trình đô thị hóa nhanh chóng là nguyên nhân của nhiều vấn đề nghiêm trọng như sự gia tăng khu ổ chuột.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. Increasing urbanization has led to problems. Cities are centers of civilization and culture.
options: A. Although increasing urbanization has led to problems, but cities are centers of civilization and culture.
B. Despite increasing urbanization has led to problems, but cities are centers of civilization and culture.
C. In spite of increasing urbanization has led to problems, yet cities are centers of civilization and culture.
D. Though increasing urbanization has led to problems, cities are centers of civilization and culture.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: “Though …” (mặc dù) diễn đạt đối lập, không đi kèm “but/yet”. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù đô thị hóa gia tăng đã dẫn đến nhiều vấn đề, các thành phố vẫn là trung tâm văn minh và văn hóa.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences given. The share price fluctuated. The trend was slightly upward.
options: A. The share price fluctuated; as the upward trend.
B. The share price fluctuated; consequently, the trend was slightly upward.
C. The share price fluctuated; due to the upward trend.
D. The share price fluctuated; however, the trend was slightly upward.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Hai mệnh đề trái ngược nhau → dùng “however”. Dịch nghĩa: Giá cổ phiếu biến động, tuy nhiên xu hướng hơi tăng.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The number of unemployed people doubled between 2005 and 2009.
options: A. Twice as many people were unemployed in 2005 compared to 2009.
B. Twice as many people were unemployed in 2009 than in 2005.
C. There were twice as many unemployed people in 2005 compared to 2009.
D. There were twice as many unemployed people in 2009 as in 2005.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: doubled = gấp đôi → “twice as many … in 2009 as in 2005”. Dịch nghĩa: Số người thất nghiệp năm 2009 gấp đôi năm 2005.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The rural population grew slowly from 1950 to 1990 and reached its peak in 1992.
options: A. The rural population experienced an upward trend from 1950 to 1992.
B. The rural population hit its highest level in 1992 after a slight increase in 40 years.
C. The rural population leveled off in 1992 after growing slowly for 40 years.
D. The rural population reached its lowest level in 1992 after growing slowly for 40 years.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Dân số nông thôn tăng chậm từ 1950–1990 và đạt đỉnh năm 1992 → “hit its highest level in 1992 after a slight increase”. Dịch nghĩa: Dân số nông thôn đạt mức cao nhất vào năm 1992 sau khi tăng nhẹ trong 40 năm.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. There was moderate fluctuation in the availability of seasonal produce.
options: A. The availability of seasonal produce experienced a stable period.
B. The availability of seasonal produce is recorded leveling off.
C. The availability of seasonal produce hardly moved up and down.
D. The availability of seasonal produce went through a period of erratic.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: moderate fluctuation = dao động nhẹ, ít thay đổi. Dịch nghĩa: Nguồn cung thực phẩm theo mùa hầu như không dao động.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Rapid ups and downs in the number of students could be observed in June.
options: A. The number of students changed dramatically in June.
B. The number of students did not stay the same in June.
C. The number of students fluctuated wildly in June.
D. The number of students went up and then fell in June.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Rapid ups and downs = dao động nhanh chóng → “fluctuated wildly”. Dịch nghĩa: Số lượng sinh viên dao động mạnh trong tháng Sáu.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. There was a 30% rise in the rate of unemployment.
options: A. There was a rise by 30% in the rate of unemployment.
B. There was a rise of 30% in the rate of unemployment.
C. There was a rise to 30% in the rate of unemployment.
D. There was a rise up 30% in the rate of unemployment.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: a 30% rise = a rise of 30%. Dịch nghĩa: Tỷ lệ thất nghiệp đã tăng 30%.
